en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Safwan, from Mansour Bin Hazim, from Ibn Abu Yafour and Anbasa Bin Mus’ab, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘When you come to the well and you are with sexual impurity and cannot find a bucket (to withdraw the water with) and there is nothing else to scoop it with, so perform Tayammum with the soil, for the Lordazwj of the water and the Lordazwj of the soil, is One; and neither fall into the well, nor spoil upon the people, their water’.
en.sarwar: 9. Muhammad ibn ’Isma’il has narrated from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan from Safwan from Mansur ibn Hazim from ibn abu Ya’qub and ‘Anbasah ibn Mus’ab who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘

When you come to a well when you have experienced sexual relation and cannot find a bucket or other means to draw water, you must take Tayammum with soil; the Lord of water and the Lord of the soil is one. Do not climb down the well and destroy people’s water.’”
